# DSA Dev Notes

> A comprehensive developer knowledge base covering DSA, JavaScript, React, Angular, Node.js, Next.js, SQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS, System Design, and interview preparation. Built by Prathamesh Pawar.

This site contains:
- 900+ technical documentation pages
- Interview question banks (easy → hard) for Angular, React, JavaScript, Node.js, TypeScript, SQL, and more
- DSA problem sets with explanations (arrays, trees, graphs, DP, etc.)
- Interactive playground and MCQ quiz tools
- System design (HLD/LLD) notes

## Key Interview Question Pages

- Angular Interview Questions (100+): /angular/interview-questions/
- JavaScript Interview Questions: /javascript/interview/
- React Interview Questions: /react/interview/
- Node.js Interview Questions: /nodejs/interview/
- DSA Interview Questions: /data-structures/interview-prep/
- Full-Stack Interview Questions: /interview/fullstack/
